description: A company's free cash flow by fiscal year (operating cash flow minus capital expenditure) with both inputs, as reported on its annual SEC filings, plus the filing links. Example questions: "What's Apple's free cash flow?"; "Has Ford's free cash flow grown?"; "10 years of FCF for COST"

ticker.description: US-listed ticker that files with the SEC, e.g. KO or BRK.B
